summary_en: Acquisition of Outsourcing Communications finalized June 1, 2026. E-Guardian now holds 100% stake (1,100 shares, full voting control). Contact center operator established March 2018, capital 55M yen. Financial impact on FY9/2026 results under review.
title_en: Notice of Completion of Stock Acquisition (Full Subsidiary Status) of Outsourcing Communications Inc.
translation_en_brief: E-Guardian Inc. announced the completion of its acquisition of Outsourcing Communications Inc. on June 1, 2026, making it a wholly owned subsidiary. The acquisition was executed via share transfer agreement as disclosed in a prior notice dated May 22, 2026. Outsourcing Communications operates a contact center business and was established in March 2018 with capital of 55 million yen. E-Guardian now holds all 1,100 shares and 100% voting control. The company stated that the financial impact on its consolidated results for the nine-month period ending September 2026 is under review and will be disclosed if material.
